patthana23.21:1.1: dhammaṃ paccayā vipāka dhammadhammo kusalo dhammā uppajjati hetupaccayā, hetuyā tīṇi.
patthana23.21:2.1: na vipākaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paccayā vipāka dhammadhammo akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. hetuyā tīṇi. na
patthana23.21:3.1: vipāka na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca neva vipāka na vipāka dhammadhammo abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā hetuyā tīṇi. na anupādinnupādāniyaṃ na kusalaṃ
